findings.summary: crates/setup/src/lib.rs:54: scrub() removes only the PEM's plain-text body lines. If kubectl or the API server ever quotes the Secret as it is stored (`data` holds the key base64-encoded), that encoding passes through unredacted into the error the script prints. Today's API errors for a Secret patch don't echo values, so this is a gap in the defence rather than a leak anyone can trigger. Redacting the base64 form of the PEM too would close it.

decision: Open the PR and advance to PR review
